title: GPU chip specification
description: Canonical spec for a single NVIDIA datacenter GPU SKU (one exact chip + form-factor + memory-config combination). All compute fields are normalized to TFLOPS/TOPS and all bandwidth fields to GB/s regardless of the units used in the original source, so records are directly comparable with jq/yq across generations.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record conforms to.

name.description: Canonical display name, including form factor/variant where it disambiguates, e.g. 'H100 SXM', 'H100 NVL 94GB'.

aliases.description: Other names this SKU is commonly referred to by (marketing names, board names, cloud-provider labels).

gpu_chip.description: Internal chip/die codename if publicly known, e.g. 'GH100', 'GB100', 'GB102'.

process_node_nm.description: Manufacturing process node in nanometers, e.g. 4 for TSMC 4N.

release_date.description: Public announcement or availability date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

form_factor.description: Physical/electrical form factor. PCIe = standard card in a PCIe slot, power-capped, NVLink absent or bridged. SXM = proprietary module soldered to an HGX baseboard, no PCIe edge connector, full NVLink domain, higher TDP ceiling. NVL = a factory-bonded pair of PCIe-form-factor cards sold as one SKU with a dedicated NVLink bridge and often higher-binned memory than the standalone PCIe card of the same chip.

sxm_generation.description: Only set when form_factor is 'SXM'. The named SXM module/socket generation, e.g. 'SXM2' (V100), 'SXM4' (A100), 'SXM5' (H100/H200), 'SXM6' (B200/B300, Blackwell/Blackwell Ultra -- same socket generation shared by both). Null for PCIe/NVL records.

nvlink_bridge_gpu_count.description: Only set when form_factor is 'NVL'. Number of GPUs connected into one NVLink-bridged group via the dedicated bridge connector for this SKU. H100 NVL ships as a factory-bonded fixed pair (bridge_gpu_count=2). H200 NVL instead ships as an individual card supporting a field-installable bridge in 2-slot or 4-slot variants (2 or 4 GPUs per group) -- record the maximum supported group size here and note the bridge-size options in 'notes'. Null for PCIe/SXM records.

slot_width.description: Number of adjacent PCIe slot positions the physical card occupies (driven by heatsink thickness, which scales with tdp_watts_max). Only meaningful for form_factor 'PCIe' or 'NVL' (each NVL card is itself a slot-width PCIe card). Null for 'SXM' -- that form factor has no PCIe edge connector/slot at all, an architectural absence rather than an unpublished figure. Typical values: 1 (low-power cards like A10, L4) or 2 (higher-TDP cards like A10G, L40S, A100 PCIe, H100 PCIe/NVL, H200 NVL).

tdp_watts_max.description: Maximum configurable thermal design power, watts. Directly drives slot_width above -- a higher TDP needs a thicker heatsink, which needs more slot positions.

fp64_tensor_tflops.description: FP64 Tensor Core throughput, dense, TFLOPS.

tf32_tensor_tflops.description: TF32 Tensor Core throughput, dense, TFLOPS.

tf32_tensor_sparse_tflops.description: TF32 Tensor Core throughput with structured sparsity, TFLOPS.

fp16_tensor_tflops.description: FP16 Tensor Core throughput, dense, TFLOPS.

fp16_tensor_sparse_tflops.description: FP16 Tensor Core throughput with structured sparsity, TFLOPS.

bf16_tensor_tflops.description: BF16 Tensor Core throughput, dense, TFLOPS.

bf16_tensor_sparse_tflops.description: BF16 Tensor Core throughput with structured sparsity, TFLOPS.

fp8_tensor_tflops.description: FP8 Tensor Core throughput, dense, TFLOPS.

fp8_tensor_sparse_tflops.description: FP8 Tensor Core throughput with structured sparsity, TFLOPS.

fp6_tensor_tflops.description: FP6 Tensor Core throughput, dense, TFLOPS. On architectures where NVIDIA publishes FP8 and FP6 as a single combined figure (shared tensor core datapath), this equals fp8_tensor_tflops — record that fact in notes.

fp6_tensor_sparse_tflops.description: FP6 Tensor Core throughput with structured sparsity, TFLOPS. See fp6_tensor_tflops note re: combined FP8/FP6 figures.

fp4_tensor_tflops.description: FP4 Tensor Core throughput, dense, TFLOPS.

fp4_tensor_sparse_tflops.description: FP4 Tensor Core throughput with structured sparsity, TFLOPS.

int8_tensor_tops.description: INT8 Tensor Core throughput, dense, TOPS.

int8_tensor_sparse_tops.description: INT8 Tensor Core throughput with structured sparsity, TOPS.

memory_capacity_gb.description: Onboard GPU memory capacity, GB (decimal, as marketed).

memory_bandwidth_gbps.description: Peak memory bandwidth, GB/s (normalized from TB/s if source used TB/s).

nvlink_generation.description: NVLink generation number, e.g. 3 (A100), 4 (H100/H200), 5 (Blackwell/Blackwell Ultra). Null if the SKU has no NVLink (e.g. most PCIe cards).

nvlink_bandwidth_gbps.description: Per-GPU bidirectional NVLink bandwidth, GB/s (normalized from TB/s if needed). Null if no NVLink.

nvlink_max_domain_size.description: Maximum number of GPUs reachable in a single unified NVLink domain that this chip participates in (e.g. 8 for an HGX baseboard GPU, 72 for a Blackwell Ultra GPU in GB300 NVL72). This is a property of the systems the chip ships in, recorded here for quick single-record lookup; the authoritative aggregate lives on the node/rack record in systems/.

c2c_bandwidth_gbps.description: NVLink-C2C bandwidth to a directly attached Grace CPU, GB/s. Null for GPUs with no CPU-coherent C2C link.

rt_cores.description: Number of dedicated ray-tracing acceleration cores. Only present on GPUs built on graphics-capable dies (e.g. A10, A10G, L4, L40S). Null for compute-only dies with no ray-tracing hardware at all (e.g. A100, H100, H200, B200, B300) -- this is an architectural absence, not a missing/unpublished figure.

rt_core_generation.description: RT Core generation number, e.g. 2nd-gen (A10, A10G), 3rd-gen (L4, L40S, Ada Lovelace). Null wherever rt_cores is null.

multi_instance_max.description: Maximum number of Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) partitions supported.

last_verified.description: Date this record's values were last checked against sources, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

notes.description: Free-text caveats: sparsity assumptions, combined/shared source figures, ambiguous table layouts, estimation methodology, etc.

sources.description: Whole-record fallback source list. Used when a source covers most/all fields and per-field citation in _sources would be redundant.

_sources.description: Per-field citations, keyed by field name. Overrides/supplements the whole-record sources[] list for fields that came from a different or more specific source (e.g. a specific datasheet page).
